deadline.value: The second round of the 42nd cycle closed on 15 June 2026, and no 2027 intake deadline is published yet, so none is stated.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the programme page or in the call.

supervisor.value: No rule requires a supervisor's agreement before admission; the call only requires a research topic agreed with the supervisor after selection.

funding.value: Funded positions and scholarships are awarded by competition on comparative merit, and the programme page lists a net monthly scholarship.
funding.quote: Admission is governed by a competition that allocates scholarships on the basis of comparative merit.

also.quote: Topic-specific positions are awarded following the ranking order of the applicants who are eligible for each position.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a second-cycle degree (Laurea Magistrale or an equivalent foreign degree) under the call's eligibility rule.
entry_route.quote: at least one of the following degrees: a) Laurea Magistrale, Magistrale a ciclo unico or Laurea Specialistica (Italian Second-Cycle Degree)

gre_general.value: The Statistics PhD lists the GRE among qualifications considered 'if available', so it is optional, not required.
